description: This dataset contains aerosol particle measurements collected at the Neumayer Station in Antarctica, with data spanning from June 2019 to November 2019. The measurements include particle number size distributions across a range of diameters, from 92.87 nm to 4845.51 nm, recorded at a fixed height of 7 meters and elevation of 42 meters. Each entry includes timestamps, geographic coordinates, and detailed particle concentration data (dN/dlogDp) for various size bins. The dataset is structured with temporal and spatial aggregation keys, making it suitable for analyzing particle behavior over time and space. Researchers can use this data to study aerosol dynamics, atmospheric composition, and environmental conditions in polar regions, supporting climate research and air quality studies.
